kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem validate-log-store --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --log-user-id 1733260000000 --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-project-name aliyun-cloudsiem-data-1733260000000-cn-hangzhou --log-store-name ssglauncher-log --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ValidateLogStore

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center for threat analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the service returns a 400 error: "The specified Lang can not be empty." This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the service returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
此参数实际为必填项，未提供时服务返回400错误「The specified Lang can not be empty.」。此参数实际为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data ingestion user
parameters.name: log_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the log storage region
parameters.name: log_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project. You can call GetDataStorage to obtain a valid project name
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务项目名称。可先调用 GetDataStorage 获取有效的日志项目名称
parameters.name: log_project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service Logstore. This parameter is actually required. You can call GetDataStorage to obtain a valid Logstore name
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务LogStore名称。此参数实际为必填项，可先调用 GetDataStorage 获取有效的日志库名称
